candidates.name: A1 ThickCCslim
candidates.role: ED direction probe: electrodes x2 thickness (overcapacity lowers effective charge SOC), CC 8/6 um, separator 10 um

candidates.name: A2 TransportCool
candidates.role: safety direction probe: transport overrides (sigma/t+/D, literature-advanced values marked estimate), particles x0.5, h=200 immersion-class cooling, area x1.5 (ED-neutral current-density dilution)

candidates.name: CeilProbe
candidates.role: opening ceiling assessment probe: best-possible architecture+formulation combo of existing system (electrodes x3, CC 4/4 um, sep 8 um, max transport, particles x0.5, h=300, area x2) — recorded for gap quantification; escalation into material design disabled (ceiling_escalation OFF)

llm_reason: Round 1 = baseline characterization + ceiling assessment + two directional probes. Baseline anchors contract-formula ED (~expected 400-430 Wh/kg) and 4C safety. A1 isolates the ED levers (thickness, thin CC/separator). A2 isolates safety levers (transport, kinetics, cooling, area). CeilProbe bounds the architecture+formulation ceiling for the opening assessment; per ablation note no material escalation regardless of the gap. Parameter sources: transport overrides are literature-advanced electrolyte estimates (marked estimate per bridge rules); all other overrides are geometry/cooling design parameters.
